choice: Adopt complete existing saltnya nuclear executor with its shared original catalog and neutron/lifetime/coolant rules. Brokestar/masson do not justify introducing a second reactor/material identity model. Retain two-phase exchange, loaded ticking membership, role controls, cooling preflight and actual acceptance, stateful placed rods, overflow recovery, original hazards, handheld Geiger and original processing/crafting quantities. Native components and typed capabilities implement platform boundaries. Native medicine recipes reuse an exactly identical existing food-processing row to avoid duplicate registration.

No new gameplay fixture. Previous logistics/legacy boiler/drill/lightning registry/data covered.
